article: 【HUGO】ローカルで環境で表示プレビュー
scope: Rewrote the Japanese Windows Hugo guide and all twelve translations. Replaced the obsolete 2022/Hugo 0.102.3 transcript, verified current WinGet installation and CLI examples against Hugo-maintained docs, clarified PATH directory setup and draft-preview behavior, preserved original publication date, and added localized official references.
findings: Removed duplicate 2026 date and retained 2022-09-05 as publication date; recorded lastmod 2026-11-24.
Replaced version-specific download transcript with current WinGet and official release archive options.
Clarified that PATH must contain the directory holding hugo.exe and that a new terminal should be opened after editing it.
Retained the valid --buildDrafts preview use, clarified the project root and server URL behavior, and warned not to publish a draft-inclusive build.
Added Hugo-maintained Windows installation, usage/draft, and hugo server references in every locale.
